info.title: Vanilla API
info.description:
HTTP API of the Vanilla chat backend.

Authentication is a session cookie set by `/auth/login` and `/auth/register` (`token`, or `__Host-Token` in production). Real-time events are delivered over the WebSocket at `/gateway`; see `docs/gateway.md`.

Errors are JSON with a stable `code`. Validation failures list one `{code, path}` per field.

get.description: Local only: refused when the request did not come straight from this machine, or came through a proxy (forwarding headers present). Used by the monitor.

delete.description: Admin only. Broadcasts INVITE_CODE_DELETE to admins.

put.description: Admin only. Badges: early_adopter, contributor, supporter, bug_hunter. `staff` follows the admin flag. Broadcasts USER_UPDATE.

delete.summary: Take a badge from a user

post.description: Multipart with one `file` field, up to MAX_ATTACHMENT_SIZE (25 MB by default). Pass the returned `id` in `attachmentIds` when sending a message within an hour, or the upload is discarded. At most 20 unclaimed uploads at a time, 30 uploads per minute.

delete.description: Development only. Fails with 500 in production.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password

204.description: Signed in. The session token is set as a cookie.

post.description: Registration may require an invite code (REGISTRATION_CLOSED).

get.description: Public: anyone with the link can fetch it, the id is unguessable. Only PNG, JPEG, GIF and WebP are served inline; every other type is a forced download.

parameters.name: filename
parameters.description: Original name, used for display only

delete.description: Needs MANAGE_CHANNELS, and never the last channel. Its messages go with it. Broadcasts CHANNEL_DELETE.

get.description: Newest first. `around` returns a page centred on that message. `limit` is 1-100, default 50.

404.description: Channel not found or not a member

post.description: Content is 1-2000 characters. Broadcasts MESSAGE_CREATE. Needs SEND_MESSAGES. Honours the channel slowmode, unless you have MANAGE_MESSAGES or MANAGE_CHANNELS.

404.description: Channel or referenced message not found

post.description: Broadcasts TYPING_START; the indicator expires after 10 seconds.

get.summary: Who is in a voice channel

post.description: Moves you out of any channel you were in. Broadcasts VOICE_STATE_UPDATE. Then open `/voice/media`.

400.description: Not a voice channel or missing clientSessionId

get.description: Most recently active first, at most 200.

post.description: Subject to the target's `dmPrivacy` and blocks. Broadcasts DM_CHANNEL_CREATE to the other person on creation.

403.description: Blocked or not allowed by their privacy setting

400.description: Too few or too many members
Not a group or too large

post.description: 6 messages per 5 seconds. Content is 1-2000 characters.

get.summary: List friends, pending requests and blocks
get.description: `kind` is FRIEND, INCOMING, OUTGOING or BLOCKED.

put.description: Also removes any friendship or request.

post.description: By `userId`, or by `username` plus `tag`. Asking someone who already asked you accepts their request. 10 per minute.

delete.summary: Unfriend, decline or cancel a request

200.description: Created server with its first channel and owner

delete.description: Owner only. Removes its channels, messages and emoji for good. Broadcasts GUILD_DELETE.

get.description: Needs VIEW_AUDIT_LOG. Newest first; page back with `before`.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Entries older than this entry id.

post.description: Needs MANAGE_EMOJIS. Multipart with a `name` field (2-32 letters, digits or underscores, unique in the server) and an image `file` (PNG, JPEG, GIF or WebP, up to 256 KB and 1024 px). At most 50 per server. Broadcasts GUILD_EMOJIS_UPDATE.

delete.description: Needs MANAGE_EMOJIS. Messages that used it show `:name:` instead. Broadcasts GUILD_EMOJIS_UPDATE.

delete.summary: Remove a member from the server
delete.description: Needs KICK_MEMBERS and a higher rank than the member. The owner cannot be removed. The member can rejoin with an invite. Broadcasts GUILD_MEMBER_REMOVE.

put.summary: Give a role to a member
put.description: Needs MANAGE_ROLES and a higher rank than the role, and you must hold every permission it grants. Broadcasts GUILD_MEMBER_UPDATE.

delete.summary: Take a role from a member
delete.description: Needs MANAGE_ROLES and a higher rank than the role. Broadcasts GUILD_MEMBER_UPDATE.

get.description: Members only. Lowest rank first; `@everyone` (the role whose id is the guild id) leads.

post.description: Needs MANAGE_ROLES and a role of your own (or ownership). The new role ranks just above `@everyone`. At most 50 per server. You cannot grant permissions you do not hold. Broadcasts GUILD_ROLES_UPDATE.
Needs MANAGE_ROLES. Send every role except `@everyone`, lowest first. Roles at or above your own rank must stay where they are. Broadcasts GUILD_ROLES_UPDATE.

400.description: The list is not every role exactly once

delete.description: Needs MANAGE_ROLES and a higher rank than the role. Members lose it. Broadcasts GUILD_ROLES_UPDATE.

patch.description: Needs MANAGE_ROLES and a higher rank than the role. `@everyone` can change only its permissions. You cannot grant permissions you do not hold. Broadcasts GUILD_ROLES_UPDATE.

post.summary: Join a server with an invite

get.description: Postgres full-text search. Filters: `from:` `in:` `mentions:` `has:link` `before:` `after:` `during:` (dates are YYYY-MM-DD). `limit` is at most 50, `offset` at most 5000.
Postgres full-text search. Filters: `from:` `in:` `mentions:` `has:link` `before:` `after:` `during:` (dates are YYYY-MM-DD). `limit` is at most 50, `offset` at most 5000.

put.summary: Set or clear your custom status
put.description: Broadcasts USER_UPDATE. Sending neither `text` nor `emoji` clears it.

post.summary: Tell your other sessions that pings were read
post.description: Pings are kept by each client; this relays PINGS_READ to all your connected sessions so they clear the same pings.

patch.description: At least one field is required. `dmPrivacy` is EVERYONE, SHARED_SERVERS or FRIENDS.

get.description: Upgrades to a WebSocket that carries binary audio and video packets plus small JSON control messages. `socket` is `audio` (default) or `video`.

width.description: Pixel size, set for images only.

url.description: Public path of the file, e.g. `/cdn/attachments/<id>/<filename>`.

actorId.description: The member who made the change; their account may have been deleted since.

targetName.description: Name at the time of the change.

changes.description: Changed fields as `{ field: [from, to] }`, or `{ field: [value] }` for one-sided notes.

has_more.description: More entries exist before the last one.

hoist.description: List members with this role in their own group.

expiresAt.description: Unix milliseconds when it clears itself.

text.description: Up to 60 characters. Leave out both `text` and `emoji` to clear the status.

emoji.description: One emoji, up to 8 characters and no spaces, or a custom one as `<:name:id>`.

durationMs.description: Milliseconds until the status clears itself (1 minute to 7 days). Omit to keep it.

deleteAt.description: Unix milliseconds when the account will be deleted.

attachmentIds.description: Ids from `POST /attachments`, at most 10. Lets `content` be empty.

Emoji.description: A custom emoji of a server. In message text it is written `<:name:id>`.

url.description: Public path of the image, e.g. `/cdn/emojis/<id>.png`.

code.description: Stable machine-readable code such as `BAD_REQUEST`, `FORBIDDEN` or `dms.errors.blocked`.

roles.description: Ids of the roles the member holds, besides `@everyone`.

ImageUpload.description: Multipart body with a single image.

attachmentIds.description: Ids from `POST /attachments`, at most 10. Lets `content` be empty.

image.description: Absolute URL of the image on the original site; clients load it through our proxy.

retryAfter.description: Milliseconds until the next attempt is allowed.

channelIds.description: Channels whose pings were read, at most 100. Omit to mark every ping read.

roleIds.description: Every role except `@everyone`, lowest rank first.

Role.description:
A server role: a name and colour for members, and the permissions it grants. The role whose
id equals the guild id is `@everyone`, held by every member.

hoist.description: Members with this role are listed in their own group, ranked by role.

total.description: Total matches, not just this page.

rateLimitPerUser.description: Slowmode in seconds, 0 to 21600. Ignored for voice channels.

oneOf.description: Always present so clearing it reaches clients that merge updates.

badges.description: Badge ids shown on the profile, e.g. `staff` or `early_adopter`.

cookie.name: token
cookie.description: Session token. Named `__Host-Token` when the server runs in production.
